description: This file implements RSA signing functions using OpenSSL in the context of the ANSC (Advanced Networking Service Container). It primarily provides the 'AnscCryptoPubSSLeayRSASign' function which signs data with RSA based on the hash size (MD5 or SHA1).

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS AnscCryptoPubSSLeayRSASign(PVOID pDataToSign,ULONG ulSizeOfData,PVOID pSignature,PULONG pulSizeOfSignature,PANSC_CRYPTO_PUB_KEY_PARAMS pParams)
methods.description: Generates an RSA signature for the provided data based on its hash size (MD5 or SHA1). Calls internal signing functions depending on the data size.
